title: US strikes Iran; tankers ablaze in Hormuz
detail: The US struck an Iranian missile site on Qeshm Island on 17 Nov after Iranian attacks on US personnel, including a 15 Nov strike on a base in Bahrain, and a third US carrier reached the Gulf. Iran's Revolutionary Guards say four tankers hit mines and caught fire in the eastern Strait; UKMTO reported a tanker hit by a projectile. Brent is still ~$92.5 as the IEA sees a ~2 mb/d surplus.
countries: SA JP KR IN CN TR IT EA
implication: Direct US-Iran exchanges raise the odds of a real Hormuz disruption, which the oil price is not pricing. Importers (JP, KR, IN, TR, IT) carry the tail risk; tanker insurance and freight are the early tells.

title: Hawkish Fed minutes; Waller floats a 50bp hike
detail: FOMC minutes showed nearly all officials see further hikes as likely; Governor Waller argued 50bp could be warranted in December. Markets price ~90% odds of 25bp and ~10% of 50bp on 9 Dec. The dollar index hit 103.9, its highest since April 2025; gold fell to $3,738 and copper to a 7-month low.
countries: US TR ZA BR AR IN ID
implication: Higher US rates and a strong dollar tighten conditions for dollar borrowers and long-duration stocks; EM currencies (lira, rand, real, peso) are most exposed.

title: US stocks −8% in a week; VIX near 36
detail: The S&P 500 fell 3.7% on 20 Nov and ~8% on the week; the Nasdaq 100 lost ~10%. Nvidia fell 14% (down over 45% from its October peak); Anthropic −11%; Broadcom, AMD, Marvell and Applied Materials each fell more than 10%. The VIX hit ~36, its highest of the year. The Nikkei fell 5%, the DAX 2.6%. SpaceX's $32bn bond sale only cleared at steep yields. Gold had its worst week in ~8 months as investors sold to raise cash.
implication: A broad deleveraging, not only an AI correction. Watch credit: if high-yield and AI-linked bond spreads widen, the sell-off becomes a financing shock. Treasuries are the haven (10-year 4.94%, down ~15bp on the week).

title: France slides toward recession
detail: Composite PMI 46.6 (September 51.1), services 46.2; Q3 GDP −0.1% q/q and industrial output −1.3% y/y.
implication: French banks and domestic cyclicals; OAT-Bund spread is the stress gauge.

title: Japan Q3 GDP flat, below forecasts
detail: Q3 GDP 0.0% q/q (−0.1% annualised) vs +0.1% expected. Yen near 159 per dollar.
implication: Weak growth and a weak yen leave the BoJ squeezed; intervention risk is high near 160.

title: China October data miss: output 4.8%, retail sales 0.4%
detail: Industrial production +4.8% y/y vs 5.3% expected; retail sales +0.4% vs 0.8% expected (autos −21.4%); October exports fell to $412bn and refinery throughput dropped.
implication: Weak China demand weighs on iron ore, copper and soy exporters (AU, BR) and Korean suppliers; raises odds of more stimulus.

title: BoE: December hike ~82% priced
detail: The BoE warned inflation could rise from 3.5% to ~5% by mid-2027; December hike odds rose to 82% from 50% a week earlier. Gilt yields rose.
implication: Gilts, housebuilders and UK consumer stocks carry the downside with consumer confidence at −24.

title: India inflation breaks the RBI's 6% ceiling
detail: October CPI 6.09% from 5.54% (food 8.94%), the first breach of the 6% band since Oct 2024; the October trade gap widened to $39.9bn.
implication: Raises odds of another RBI hike; pressure on the rupee and rate-sensitive Indian stocks.

title: Australian unemployment jumps to 4.9%
detail: October jobless rate 4.9% vs 4.7% expected, the highest since Oct 2021; employment fell 43,500 vs +25,000 expected. This follows the RBA hike to 4.85% (an 18-year high) and a 48.2 composite PMI.
implication: Raises the risk the RBA over-tightened; AUD, banks and housing-linked stocks carry the downside.

title: Bank Indonesia surprises with a hike to 6%
detail: BI raised its policy rate 25bp to 6.00% against expectations of a hold, with inflation only 3.23%, to defend the rupiah against the strong dollar.
implication: Shows strong-dollar pressure forcing EM central banks to tighten; watch for similar moves in IN, TR and ZA.

title: South Africa: inflation jumps to 5.2%; SARB split
detail: October CPI rose to 5.2% from 4.5%. The SARB held at 7.25% but three of seven members voted to hike, and it sees inflation above 5% into early 2027.
implication: A hike in January is now live; rand and local bonds are the pressure points with the dollar strong.

title: Japan inflation 2.3%, highest in a year
detail: October CPI 2.3% from 2.1%; core 2.2%. Keeps BoJ hike talk alive with the yen near 159.

title: UK and Canada retail sales beat
detail: UK October retail sales +2.3% y/y vs 1.7% expected; Canada September +7.5% y/y. Consumers held up before the market sell-off.

title: UK inflation 3.6%, below forecast
detail: October CPI 3.6% vs 3.7% expected; core 2.8%. Euro-area final HICP confirmed at 4.0%.

title: Brazil business confidence slumps
detail: Business confidence fell to 40.2 from 46.2 in November after a 44.4 composite PMI. The real fell past 5.65 per dollar on a fiscal bill seen as too timid.
implication: Selic cuts become the question; BRL and local bonds are the pressure points.

title: Euro-area inflation at 4.0%
detail: October CPI 4.0% from 3.8%; Italy 5.4%. Euro-area Q3 GDP +0.4% q/q, retail sales +0.4% y/y.
implication: ECB hike bias persists while growth slows; periphery spreads widen first.

title: Copper stocks swell ahead of US tariffs
detail: LME copper stocks ~320,000t from 205,000t in August as metal is diverted to the US before possible import tariffs; copper at a four-month low near $6.0/lb.
implication: Tariff front-running is distorting copper signals; a weak price partly reflects China demand.

title: UK grew 0.7% in Q3
detail: In line with forecasts, led by services. Backward-looking after the BoE hike.

title: Baltic Dry snaps a 7-day run
detail: Down 1.3% to 2,980; still +12% on the month.

title: Gold at its lowest since Oct 2025
detail: Near $3,850 on a strong dollar and higher yields.

title: Anthropic IPO expected this week
detail: Reportedly heavily oversubscribed. Market sentiment item, not a macro signal.
